title: OpenAI quietly boosts some of Astra's evaluation metrics, and continues to change others post-launch
summary: OpenAI quietly boosts some of Astra's evaluation metrics, and continues to change others post-launch Fortune
body: OpenAI quietly boosts some of Astra's evaluation metrics, and continues to change others post-launch Fortune
summaryZh: 媒体报道称，OpenAI在发布Astra后，悄然对其部分评估指标进行了提升，并在后续阶段持续修改相关测试参数。这一举动引发了外界对大模型发布后基准衡量标准一致性和透明度的讨论。原始信息显示：OpenAI quietly boosts some of Astra's evaluation metrics, and continues to change others post-launch Fortune。该消息由Fortune发布，主题为“OpenAI quietly boosts some of Astra's evaluation metrics, and continues to change others post-launch”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI在模型发布后对其Astra系统的部分评测指标进行了静默调整。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
